name: caveman
description: An output style that strips the padding out of Claude's replies. No "I'll now", no apology, no restating your question — one fact per line, numbers instead of adjectives. Code, commands, paths and error text stay byte-exact, and so does anything written to disk. Install, then pick caveman:Caveman in /config — plugin output styles are namespaced, and the picker moved out of /output-style.
